definitions.ask: Should the default all-projects table also nest each multi-repo project's code repos under its row?
definitions.why: That table compares projects; the -g repo tree already answers per-repo at that scope

choices.label: One row per project; per-repo counts live in the one-project card and the -g repo tree
Dim repo sub-rows under each multi-repo project; the all-projects table roughly triples in height
